name: twitter-research
description: Read-only Twitter/X research toolkit: a curated menu of 9 SELAT-native (catalog.selat.ai) GET endpoints covering account reads (profile, recent tweets, mentions, followers), tweet reads (details, replies, retweeters), topic search, and trends. The agent selects only the endpoints a request needs; each call is ~$0.001, x402 via Circle Gateway. No API keys.

handle.description: Twitter/X handle without the @ (e.g. openai, sama, AnthropicAI) — for the account-read endpoints.

query.description: Search query for the topic-search endpoint. Supports X operators (from:, $TICKER, #tag, min_faves:, since:, lang:).

tweetId.description: Numeric tweet ID for the tweet-read endpoints (details, replies, retweeters). Default 20 is the first tweet ever.

woeid.description: Yahoo WOEID for trends (1 = worldwide, 23424977 = United States, 2459115 = New York City).

steps.label: account profile — SELAT Twitter user/info (x402 via Circle Gateway)
recent tweets — SELAT Twitter user/last_tweets (x402 via Circle Gateway)
mentions — SELAT Twitter user/mentions (x402 via Circle Gateway)
followers — SELAT Twitter user/followers (x402 via Circle Gateway)
topic search — SELAT Twitter advanced_search (x402 via Circle Gateway)
trends — SELAT Twitter trends by WOEID (x402 via Circle Gateway)
tweet details — SELAT Twitter tweets by id (x402 via Circle Gateway)
tweet replies — SELAT Twitter tweet/replies (x402 via Circle Gateway)
tweet retweeters — SELAT Twitter tweet/retweeters (x402 via Circle Gateway)
